options: The business unit assigned the Procurement business function
The business unit that pays all supplier invoices
A type of purchase order used only for services
The business unit the requester belongs to, where a requisition originates
questions.explain: The requisitioning BU is the requester's own business unit - in this course, the plant where Dana works.

questions.q: Can one procurement BU provide purchasing services to more than one requisitioning BU?
options: Yes, this is common when a company centralizes purchasing into a shared services function
No, every requisitioning BU must have its own dedicated procurement BU
Only if both BUs are in different countries
Only for service purchase orders, never for goods
questions.explain: A single procurement BU can service one or many requisitioning BUs, which is typical in centralized/shared-services purchasing models.

questions.q: What has to be assigned to a business unit before it can own purchase orders and agreements?
options: The Receivables business function
The Procurement business function
A supplier site
A procurement card
questions.explain: A BU must be assigned the Procurement business function to become a procurement BU capable of owning purchasing documents.

options: A piece of software that automatically approves purchase orders
A supplier's sales representative
A person explicitly authorized to create and manage purchasing documents on behalf of a specific procurement BU
A report that lists all open purchase orders
questions.explain: A procurement agent is a named person tied to a procurement BU, authorized to act as a buyer for that BU - this is what makes Marcus able to own purchase orders.

questions.q: If Marcus held every relevant job role and privilege but was never assigned as a procurement agent for LTV's procurement BU, what would happen?
options: He could still create purchase orders because job roles are all that matter
He would still not be authorized to own purchasing documents in that BU
The system would automatically assign him as an agent after his first login
He would become a requester instead
questions.explain: The procurement agent assignment, tied to a specific procurement BU, is a separate requirement from job roles and privileges - without it, he cannot act as a buyer there.
